newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya shilling gains vs dlr checked, firm on pound.
newsitem.headline: Kenya shilling gains vs dlr checked, firm on pound.

text.p: A large buying order on Thursday checked gains made by the Kenyan shilling against the dollar on Wednesday, commercial bank dealers said.
Against the dollar, the Central Bank of Kenya posted a shilling mean rate of 54.37 from 54.64 while against the pound, it was posted at a mean of 90.53 from 91.22.
The money market tightened marginally on tax outflows. Overnight rates were quoted at 13-15 percent from 11 percent on Wednesday.
